notes_blind_original: Puzzle for the reconciler: the regression behind Figure 4b (C6, b = 0.174) reproduces, yet the ±1 SD predicted means (C1-C4) do not, and the report says Figure 4 'Code generates the data, but not the figure' (p.6). The report does not say whether the predicted means came from shipped code or replicator-written prediction code, nor why they differ; hence medium confidence and P2 rather than P1. The version pin lists two deposits each of Analyses.R and Cleaning.R (2022 and later); the report does not say which it ran. Report's own summary: main results reproduced, 'discrepancies in some secondary statistics'.
